-- Only this fixed actual GIC instance is needed by the closure lemma.
example {V : Type} {mem : V → V → Prop} (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (a : V)
    (hG : Sat mem (fun _ => a) (ProfileSyntax.gicForm WellFoundedPart.witnessForm))
    (ha : ∀x, mem x a → WellFoundedPart.WF mem x) : WellFoundedPart.WF mem a :=
  WellFoundedPart.wf_closure B a hG ha

-- The formula is literally allowed even by equality-free GIC.
example {V : Type} {mem : V → V → Prop} (B : FiniteSets.Base mem)
    (hG : ProfileModel.ModelsGIC mem) (a : V)
    (ha : ∀x, mem x a → WellFoundedPart.WF mem x) : WellFoundedPart.WF mem a :=
  WellFoundedPart.wf_closure_of_equalityFree_gic B hG a ha

-- The actual quotient gives an inhabited internally regular WF substructure.
example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    Nonempty (WellFoundedPart.Domain (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h)) ∧
      ∀ env, Sat (WellFoundedPart.domainMem (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h))
        env Reg_form :=
  ⟨WellFoundedPart.quotient_domain_nonempty mem witness h,
    WellFoundedPart.domain_regular _⟩

-- The internal minimal-element theorem has no external WellFounded premise.
example {V : Type} {mem : V → V → Prop} (a : V)
    (ha : WellFoundedPart.WF mem a) (hne : ∃ x, mem x a) :
    ∃m, mem m a ∧ WellFoundedPart.WF mem m ∧ ∀z, mem z m → ¬ mem z a :=
  WellFoundedPart.wf_minimal a ha hne
